statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-8769 is a low-severity uncontrolled resource consumption issue in @ai-sdk/provider-utils. Scout reports no fixed version yet across the 2.x and 3.x lines present in the Trigger.dev monorepo lockfile. Tracking upstream @ai-sdk releases for a patched provider-utils and evaluating whether the webapp's AI SDK call paths are reachable by unauthenticated users.
